source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
Each time a **[BLAST]** weapon's [attack dice are gathered](vsdata:core-rule/resolve-attacks), add 1 die per 5 models the target unit had at the [Select Targets](vsdata:core-rule/select-targets) step, rounded down; a **[BLAST X]** weapon adds X dice per 5 models instead.

24.05 sets no engagement limit of its own, but:

- [Close-Quarters Shooting](vsdata:core-rule/close-quarters-shooting) (10.06) bars a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** model's **[BLAST]** attacks against units engaged with the firing unit.
- The rules FAQ bars **[BLAST]** weapons against an [engaged MONSTER or VEHICLE unit](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-at-engaged-monsters-and-vehicles).

engagementElsewhere.scope: MONSTER or VEHICLE models using Close-Quarters Shooting
engagementElsewhere.rule: [BLAST] attacks cannot target a unit engaged with the firing unit

engagementElsewhere.source: FAQ p88 and p63 diagram caption
engagementElsewhere.scope: any unit shooting an engaged MONSTER or VEHICLE unit
